changelog:
- Home Page Controls: Resolved intermittent button unresponsiveness (3-dot menu, tabs, ghost mode, favorites) and added missing native bridge methods.
- Dual-Screen Split View: Hydrated suspended secondary tabs on-demand to eliminate blank white viewports.
- Video Playback Screen-On: Integrated FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON during fullscreen and inline video playback to prevent screen timeouts.
- Fullscreen Video Overlap Fix: Corrected onResume topBar re-display conflict and increased fullscreen container elevation to 20dp.
- Modern Docked Command Bar: Switched to edge-to-edge docked UI with 1dp border and adjusted content margins.
- Performance & Stability: Scoped JSON.parse defuser to YouTube only and eliminated high-frequency Instagram DOM polling.
- Web App Prompts & Deceptive Overlays: Scrubbed Bing mobile 'Open App' banners and fully wired AI Trap Defuser into live mutation checks.
